pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**

/kind bug

**What this PR does / why we need it**:

Fix kube-proxy cleanup.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #94914

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

kube-proxy replay ip protocol to init iptables interface, and need hostName and ClientConnectionConfiguration to decide ip protocol, so user need specify those config in cleanup.

Cleanup action should clean all rules that kube-proxy created, include IPv4 and IPv6 rules, and user don't have to specify any other config.


**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
NONE
```

issue_context.title: kube-proxy cleanup not work
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:

Currently kube-proxy cleanup not work, which will left iptables (and ipvs) rules in host and.

```
./_output/bin/kube-proxy --cleanup
W0919 16:21:16.970463   11908 server.go:226] WARNING: all flags other than --config, --write-config-to, and --cleanup are deprecated. Please begin using a config file ASAP.
I0919 16:21:16.970684   11908 server.go:555] Neither kubeconfig file nor master URL was specified. Falling back to in-cluster config.
F0919 16:21:16.970703   11908 server.go:495] unable to load in-cluster configuration, KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST and KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT must be defined
```

**What you expected to happen**:

Kube-proxy cleanup can work and not relay on hostName or ClientConnection config.

**How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)**:

`kube-proxy --cleanup`

review_comments:
So this will end up logging an error if `ip6tables` is uninstalled (even though there presumably weren't IPv6 iptables rules to clean up in that case). But that will need to be fixed to reconcile this with #94474 anyway.

If this is only going into 1.20 I'd rather hold this until #94474 and then rebase on top of that, but if this was going to be backported to 1.19 then it might be better to just merge this as-is and ignore the somewhat spurious error message in that case...

I think cherry-pick to 1.19 is necessary, obviously 1.19 have this problem. 
But currently I have no idea about how to avoid spurious error message in this case, so maybe hold this until #94474 and then rebase on top of that still an option.
